quotes: Indeed, the strength of our HEA favorably compares with that of other conventional superalloys and reported refractory HEAs at temperatures ranging from 25 °C to 800 °C

We believe that the combination of yield strength, tensile strength and tensile ductility displayed by the W-based refractory HEA with the SCCPs structure is superior to previously reported tungsten-based, Ni-based superalloys, and refractory HEAs
our alloy displays an ultrahigh strength of 2.15 GPa with a tensile ductility of 15% at ambient temperature

records.text: Intervention effect. Base system: SCCPs alloy. Intervention: Comparison of SCCPs alloy with other conventional superalloys and refractory HEAs. Processing: Uniaxial tensile tests at 25 °C to 800 °C. Test conditions: 25 °C to 800 °C. Structure change: SCCPs structure with coherent δ and γ″ precipitates. Property change: Superior combination of yield strength, tensile strength, and ductility compared to other reported alloys. Mechanism: Synergistic effect of coherent nanoprecipitations and homogeneous distribution. Evidence: measured. Quote: "Indeed, the strength of our HEA favorably compares with that of other conventional superalloys and reported refractory HEAs at temperatures ranging from 25 °C to 800 °C"
